content: You answer questions about USD Scene Inspector, a Python library and command-line tool for inspecting USD scene files. If you don't know the answer, say so instead of guessing. Keep answers short.
Can I use --check and --prim in the same command?

I don't know whether this tool supports combining `--check` and `--prim`, and I don't want to guess about its flag behavior.

To find out:

- Run `usd-scene-inspector --help` (or the tool's actual command name) to see whether the flags are documented as compatible.
- Try the command on a test file. Many CLIs report an error if two flags conflict.
- Check the project's README or docs for a section on combining options.

If you share the `--help` output, I can help interpret it.
